## 2. Bundled executables and native libraries

### FFmpeg and ffprobe

- **Version:** n9.0.2-57-gd838f9f9ae
- **Licence:** `GPL-3.0-or-later`
- **Copyright:** Copyright (c) 2000-2026 the FFmpeg developers
- **Upstream:** https://ffmpeg.org/
- **Source:** https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/tree/d838f9f9ae

FFmpeg and ffprobe are built by [BtbN FFmpeg Builds](https://github.com/BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds)
as the GPL static variant, release `autobuild-2026-11-15-12-40`, version
`n9.0.2-57-gd838f9f9ae`. The shipped `ffmpeg -buildconf` output is captured by
the release build into `LICENSES/ffmpeg/BUILDINFO.txt`.

The GPL build statically includes, among others, `libmp3lame` (LGPL-2.1),
`librubberband` (GPL-2.0-or-later), `libx264` and `libx265` (GPL-2.0-or-later),
`libsoxr` (LGPL-2.1), `libopus` and `libvorbis` (BSD-3-Clause), zlib, and
OpenSSL (Apache-2.0). The exact list and commits are recorded in
`LICENSES/ffmpeg/BUILDINFO.txt` and the release's third-party source bundle.
`ffplay`, the documentation, and the presets are not shipped.

Licence text: [`GPL-3.0-or-later`](./LICENSES/common/GPL-3.0-or-later.txt).

See [`LICENSES/ffmpeg/`](./LICENSES/ffmpeg/).

- **Licence:** `GPL-2.0-or-later`
- **Copyright:** Copyright (c) 2007-2024 Particular Programs Ltd t/a Breakfast Quay
- **Upstream:** https://breakfastquay.com/rubberband/

- **Upstream:** https://libsndfile.github.io/libsndfile/

Deno 2.9.8 is the JavaScript runtime used by yt-dlp's EJS solver. It is shipped

`yt-dlp` (Unlicense) performs the YouTube download and `yt-dlp-ejs` (Unlicense
AND MIT AND ISC) provides the JavaScript challenge solver, which runs on the
bundled Deno. Both ship as Python wheels inside the frozen payload; neither

## 4. Native runtime libraries

These libraries are conveyed inside wheels rather than by StemForge's own
build. GCC runtime libraries and the platform/compiler runtime are treated
as **System Libraries** under GPLv3 section 1: they are noticed here and
excluded from the Corresponding Source bundle.

### PyTorch

- **Version:** 2.15.0+cpu
- **Licence:** `BSD-3-Clause`
- **Copyright:** Copyright (c) 2016-present Facebook, Inc. and contributors
- **Upstream:** https://pytorch.org/
- **Source:** https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/tree/v2.15.0

PyTorch 2.15.0+cpu is the CPU-only wheel. Its `dist-info/licenses/` tree
(BSD-3-Clause for PyTorch plus oneDNN, fbgemm, LLVM OpenMP, sleef, protobuf and
other third-party notices) is pooled verbatim under `LICENSES/texts/` and
indexed in `LICENSES/python/DEPENDENCIES.md`. The Linux wheel also conveys GCC
runtime libraries and the Windows wheel conveys `libiomp5md.dll`; both are

## 6. Model weights — not included

StemForge does **not** include the Demucs `htdemucs` weights. They are
downloaded from Hugging Face at the user's explicit request, at a pinned
revision and verified by SHA-256, and are **not covered by StemForge's
GPL-3.0 licence**. The Demucs author states that the weights' licence is
unclear because the training data included research-only MusDB material.
See [ADR 0009](https://github.com/alexmarincu/stemforge/blob/main/docs/adr/0009-demucs-weights-are-downloaded-not-bundled.md)
and <https://github.com/adefossez/demucs#license>.

No model weights, `*.safetensors`, or Hugging Face URL are part of this
licence tree or any StemForge artifact.

---

## 7. Host dependencies — not distributed

These are required on the user's machine but are not part of StemForge's
bundle. Their terms are between the user and their OS or platform vendor:

- **Linux:** GTK 3, WebKitGTK 4.1, GStreamer with `gst-plugins-good`,
  PyGObject, glibc, and the distribution's audio stack.
- **Windows:** Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime, the .NET runtime required
  by pythonnet, and the Microsoft Visual C++ runtime.

If a future packaging change bundles any of these, this notice and the
source offer must be reopened.

---

## 8. Build-only tools — not distributed

Inno Setup, `uv`, GitHub Actions runners, and the compilers used to build
the bundles are build-time tools. The distributed exceptions are
PyInstaller's bootloader (noticed above) and the Inno Setup loader
embedded in the Windows installer, whose licence permits royalty-free
distribution of generated installers.

## 9. Source offer

Under GPL-3.0-only section 6(b), StemForge offers the complete
Corresponding Source for every GPL-licensed binary it ships. The offer is
valid for three years from the release date (2026-2029).
Requests go to https://github.com/alexmarincu/stemforge/issues. The same-place offer under
section 6(d) is on the release page, https://github.com/alexmarincu/stemforge/releases.

See [`SOURCE_OFFER.md`](./SOURCE_OFFER.md).
